items.title: Pay roof gutter invoice
items.computation: Private invoice between a company and a person, counted under §§ 187, 188, 193 BGB. Start event: invoice date 20.11.2026, which is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 30 days forward from 20.11.2026: 10 remaining days of November (21–30 Nov) plus 20 days into December lands on 20.12.2026. 20.12.2026 is a Sunday. Since this is a payment deadline, § 193 BGB moves the end to the next working day. Payer's Land is NRW (person lives there, relevant for payments owed by the person per § 270 Abs. 4 BGB analogy); 21.12.2026 (Monday) is not a public holiday in NRW, so it is the due date.
